firstImage.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the scene edit target. Image2 is the authoritative CHARACTER GEOMETRY reference: ONLY MIMO TOP ROW. Image3 is human body simplification reference, NOT a pose or layout reference. Produce a square image retaining image1 composition: kneeling white faceless toddler center-left, two raised open palms refusing teddy offered by cropped adult hand from left, small Mimo standing right, plenty of blank space above. Keep refusal unmistakable, palm hands away from toy with clear gap. Preserve five fingers per open human hand, no extra digits. No change of story, no text or extra props. Correct Mimo to TOP ROW of image2: smooth vertically egg-shaped head with no cheek lobes or muzzle, head width/height about122/133, single slender leaf crest, small vertical eyes, tiny diamond beak with central division; concerned short eyebrows; white short-sleeved shirt with distinct sleeve boundaries and curved hem separating shirt and lower body, slender bird legs. Head should be proportional to full height exactly as reference, not giant chibi head. Mimo's wings gently lowered open, not human hands, keep it smaller than child. Rounded two-lobe orange collar and short side knot, orange two-dot U chest mark #FF511B flat solid. Animal outline/eyes/beak #5C5148 consistent medium-thin smooth rounded strokes. Toddler silhouette remains faceless, modestly plump limbs, rounded head; simplify hair to smooth short-hair outer contour with only TWO gentle rounded tufts, no jagged spikes, no interior hair strands. Keep head turn and refusal pose. Child outline #F59B82 smooth, uniform, no rough scratchy grain. Adult cropped hand outline lighter/thinner #F7C6B3. Child and animal outer strokes similar weight, adult 75% of child weight; internal lines 75% of outer. White fills. Background warm white #FFFCF7, remove orange glow and paper texture, replace scribbled ground shadows with very faint smooth warm contact shadows #EEDCC6 at35% opacity. Teddy pale muted honey/cream with finer warm tan line, no shine. Retain subtle lavender gesture marks sparsely, not large. Do not import reference image labels, arrows, other animals or standing toddler poses. Shapes and intended action must survive at small mobile card size. Output square 1254x1254 if supported.

Targeted follow-up:
Precise local correction of image1. Image2 top row MIMO FRONT is the exact shape guide. Keep all scene positions, child gesture, teddy and blank space. Critical corrections: Mimo head must be SMOOTH SYMMETRICAL EGG with no cheek bump on left or right, no indentation halfway down; copy FRONT top-row reference silhouette at current head size. Keep concerned eyebrows and small eyes. Mimo collar: TWO equal ROUND SCALLOPED lobes beneath chin, same as FRONT reference; one short side knot to viewer RIGHT only; REMOVE the extra orange teardrop/tie at front viewer LEFT completely. There must be no front hanging tie. Keep white shirt sleeves/hem and bird feet. Child hair: remove all sharp pointed or hooked tufts; replace entire hair edge with one smooth dome and only TWO small ROUND bumps at top-left, NO pointed tufts, NO hair interior lines. Preserve original child's head direction and body/raised palms. Child outline uniform muted coral #F59B82, not bright orange. Adult cropped hand much paler #F7C6B3, thinner. Mimo outline #5C5148. Orange collar and chest mark #FF511B. Smooth warm-white background. No added elements. Output same dimensions.
firstImage.review: 造形・動作を目視照合後、部位別に指定色を直接適用。境界の混色を維持。線幅の厳密な適合は未検証。

headCorrection.prompt: Precise local edit. IMAGE1 is the EDIT TARGET, IMAGE2 is the approved toddler BODY/HEAD MODEL reference. Fix ONLY the child's head in image1, roughly x390..730,y215..575. Current head is a balloon-like circle with two bumps on top; this is WRONG. Replace with anatomically simplified toddler head based on LEFT CHILD in image2: rounded broad cranium, distinct softer lower cheeks tapering toward a small rounded chin, short neck, natural small ear at correct side-of-head height, NOT a circle and NOT a bird head. Show the head in a gentle LEFT-facing three-quarter/profile turn toward the offered teddy. A restrained forehead-to-tiny-nose-to-rounded-cheek-to-chin silhouette should make head orientation clear. Face interior blank: NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO mouth, NO internal facial detail. Hair should be a smooth cap silhouette integrated into skull; REMOVE both top bumps completely, NO hair tufts or spikes. Keep approximate head height but reduce inflated cranial width about10%, maintain connection to SAME neck and shirt. IMPORTANT preserve child raised refusing palms, fingers, body, arms, legs, teddy, adult hand, Mimo, gesture marks, ground shadows and composition. Do not recolor or restyle anything else. Head fill pure #FFFFFF, outline exact #F59B82 with same thin smooth rounded stroke as child's body. Background #FFFCF7. Mimo must stay EXACTLY unchanged, including dark brown outlines #5C5148 and orange scarf #FF511B. Preserve all existing flat colors. Output same1254x1254 canvas. This is a head-shape correction only, no text or new objects.
headCorrection.method: 内蔵imagegenで頭部を修正し、頭・首の範囲だけ合成。線色を #F59B82 に再適用。

Preserve IMAGE1 composition and teaching meaning exactly: kneeling toddler LEFT pointing index finger at COOKIE icon in six-cell AAC board lower center; adult RIGHT facing child holding matching large cookie; small Mimo lower right with wing near beak listening. Keep six icons cookie/teddy/cup,car/banana/bubbles in same order. Keep positions, relative scale and pointing fingertip contact on cookie card, cookie held by adult. No new objects or text. Child head: natural rounded cranium with small nose, soft cheek and tapered rounded chin, tiny ear, head angled RIGHT/down toward board; blank face no eyes/mouth; NO circular balloon head, no head tufts. Adult head: simple smooth bob silhouette, forehead small nose chin and optional simple ear, no individual hairs, no facial features. Modestly rounded child limbs. Add simple short-sleeve shirt boundary if needed; white human interiors. Mimo smooth egg head width/height122/133 proportion as top row of image3, no cheek bumps, small vertical eyes, tiny diamond beak, single leaf crest. White short-sleeve shirt with curved hem separating torso, two round scalloped orange collar lobes and short side knot viewer right, orange two-dot U chest mark; no front hanging tie. Palette and strokes: child #F59B82 smooth uniform outer4 and inner3; adult #F7C6B3 outer3 inner2.5, distinctly lighter and thinner; animal outline/eyes/beak #5C5148 outer4 internal3 detail2.5; scarf/logo #FF511B flat. Retain four small communication dots without glow, no decorative radiating lines around people. Output1254x1254.
